_comment: The budgets skills/audit/scripts/fleet_check.py reports against. testSeconds is the wall time of every tests/test_*.py module run in parallel. docWords counts tracked markdown outside skills/, and skillWords counts tracked markdown under skills/. Raise a number only with the story that needs the room. The testCount of 572 is the measured count after the stories that followed the raise-cap, run-tests snapshot and isolation work (#81, #115, #110, #112) added a test for each gate they shipped, plus the two that guard this budget check (#172), the one for the groom sweep (#206) and one each for the commit-msg story check and the close script (#189). Trimming tests would remove that coverage, so the count is raised and the word budgets are held by trimming. The testSeconds of 60 was measured at 56.3 on 2026-11-11. Three modules (test_gate_secrets, test_owner_identifiers, test_size_ratchet) each start real git repositories to run the hooks end to end, and they take 50, 32 and 30 seconds in parallel. Faking git would remove the only check that the hooks block a real commit, so the budget records the cost. The testCount rose from 572 to 590 on 2026-11-11 for the 19 tests that cover placement (olivercode place, clean and the creation gate). The contextWords of 1800 is the most the always-loaded files (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, VOICE.md and the repo CLAUDE.md) may hold; they held 1336 on 2026-11-11. The testCount rose on 2026-11-11 for the tests that cover the failure log, learning proposals, agent jobs, memory and version health, the activation-link check, the voice override, the clean-clone install and the offered bootstrap files.
